_about: Tidebreak round 3: the % ring's HUD (PERCENT's; smash_r3 spec v2 §10, §14.2; PercentBar, scripts/ui/percent_bar.gd, in place of the MatchBar while a stock-rules ring is on). A scoreboard on fixed plates, never a cue on a body: the plates change only on hits, falls, heals, your own air moves and the clock; they read RingRules, RingMode and your own RingMoves, never any position. Sizes in px at 1280x720 (scaled with the window's height).
_layouts: A: your plate top-left at `at`, theirs top-right mirrored, the clock top-centre, the event line under it. B: the bottom corners (rendered for the owner). team: 3v3's smaller plates, stacked.
_ramp: the % digits' colour by % (an OKLab blend between the stops); above throb_from they throb throb_lo..1 at throb_hz; outline from the last stop on
_hit: on a hit: the digits roll up over roll_s, pop to 1 + min(pop_k delta, pop_max) over pop_s, and shake clamp(shake_a + shake_k delta, shake_min, shake_max) px at shake_hz, decaying over shake_s; on a heal they roll down with a pale-green flash (heal_flash_s)
_fall: a fall on the plate: a white flash at flash_s, the digits rising rise_px and fading by fade_s, a life glyph cracking and dropping by crack_s (the row closing up), "0%" fading in at zero_s
_pips: your own plate only: jump, dodge, Rise (RingMoves.of(player): jumps_left, dodge_ready, rise_ready); a pip dims when spent and refills with a soft tick
_fresh: your own plate only: the fresh pool (RingRules.fresh_pct: what Patch may take back) as a lighter band at the end of a thin % bar under the digits (full at bar_full_pct)
_wake: launch_wake (default false): at wake_mps or more, wake_s of the hitter's matter behind the body; default instead a bigger burst at the hit point (burst_n bits at burst_mps). respawn_drip (default false): a drip off the respawned body for drip_s
_r4: Round 4 (HUD; the owner: "a cleaner HUD", "those big cards are terrible"): the strip off the player's body, one type system (the plates' digits, 16 px heads and names, 13 px hints), one ink outline, gold only for the readied chip and the caught stone's line. strip_layout: L1 the whole strip bottom-left under your plate (the default: its rects meet the body's box under neither camera A nor C), L2 split either side of the body, L3 a compact centre (rendered for the owner). Sizes in px at 1280x720 (the strip keeps its px; L2's split and the shade grow with the height).
_centre: RingMode's centre words (the countdown, the fall's line, "Over"): the banner banner_px at banner_at of the height, the sub line sub_px under it, the top line top_y under the plates
_contrast: the deck under the strip for the contrast check (tests/ring/test_r4_hud.gd): its mean colour at noon and at night, read off the review frames

words._about: The plates' own words (no show words, no Smash names).
words.event_you: You are in the water  ·  %d left
